stem: Which statement best describes Technician I authority?
choices: Execute defined work, verify required conditions, document results, and escalate outside the assigned boundary
Redesign controlled procedures whenever production needs change
Authorize hazardous servicing after reading the SOP
Approve permanent deviations when a supervisor is unavailable
rationale: Technician I is an execution-and-escalation role, not the authority for redesigning procedures, hazardous servicing, or permanent deviations.
